desc_en: A sophisticated silhouette defined by a seductive halter neck and open back design. Crafted from a soft, skin-friendly stretchy blend. Adjustable drawstrings on both sides allow you to customize the fit. Nothing in our brand is mass-produced. Each piece exists because you have ordered it. Available with worldwide shipping.

Los cordones ajustables a los lados permiten personalizar el ajuste con precisión. Cero producción masiva. Cada pieza existe porque usted la ha pedido. Disponible con envío a todo el mundo.
